kantoor.label: Office
kantoor.note: Standard comfort ventilation. Demand-controlled operation on CO₂ delivers the largest saving here; check that the ductwork and the diffusers can handle the minimum airflow rate.
kantoor.basis: EN 16798-1 cat. II; EN 16798-3 for filtration

school.label: School / classrooms
school.note: High occupant density and a strict noise requirement. The acoustic criterion, not the airflow rate, usually determines the casing size here.
school.basis: EN 16798-1; national indoor air quality requirements for education

woningbouw.label: Collective residential
woningbouw.note: No carry-over between dwellings: that rules out rotary exchangers and demands attention to the leak-tightness of the casing (class L1) and of the ductwork.

winkel.label: Shop / retail
winkel.note: Strongly varying occupancy and high lighting and cooling loads. Ask for the opening hours: the installation often keeps running outside office hours.

sporthal.label: Sports hall
sporthal.note: High latent load from physical exertion; long throw distances. Check the supply air configuration separately from the air handling unit.

museum.label: Museum / archive / store
museum.note: The permitted RH band and above all the permitted rate of change are the real design criterion here. Gas-phase filtration against SO₂/NOₓ/ozone is usually required.
museum.basis: EN 16893; conservation requirements of the collection

zwembad.label: Swimming pool / wellness
zwembad.note: Chloramines make any rotary exchanger unsuitable and attack aluminium and galvanised steel. The installation is a dehumidifier with heat recovery, not an ordinary air handling unit: the moisture balance of the water surface determines the airflow rate.
zwembad.basis: VDI 2089; EN 16798; national swimming pool guidelines

keuken.label: Commercial kitchen / catering
keuken.note: Grease and odour rule out recirculation and rotary exchangers. A twin-coil or a heat pipe with cleanable coils is the usual solution; always ask about the cleaning regime on the extract side.

wasserij.label: Laundry
wasserij.note: Lint, vapour and heat at the same time. The extract side fouls quickly: ask about cleanability and about the position of the lint filter upstream of the exchanger.
wasserij.basis: Process ventilation; HIT 4A — hot and humid processes

ziekenhuis.label: Hospital — general areas
ziekenhuis.note: Three-stage filtration and full leak-tightness. Cross-contamination through the heat recovery is not permitted; the pressure regime between zones is a design requirement, not a commissioning matter.

operatiekamer.label: Operating theatre
operatiekamer.note: Final filtration sits in the ceiling, not in the air handling unit — ask explicitly where the H14 is installed and who leak-tests it. Pressure cascade and recovery time after door opening are the governing performance requirements.
operatiekamer.basis: DIN 1946-4; ISO 14644; national operating theatre guidelines

labo.label: Laboratory
labo.note: Fume cupboards determine the airflow rate and its variation. No form of carry-over or recirculation whatsoever; twin-coil is the standard solution because the media stay completely separated.
labo.basis: EN 14175 (fume cupboards); national occupational hygiene rules

gmp.label: Pharmaceutical / GMP
gmp.note: Qualification (DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ) belongs in the enquiry, not in the handover. Ask the manufacturer for documentation and material certificates from the order onwards — afterwards this can no longer be reconstructed.

cleanroom.label: Cleanroom (industrial)
cleanroom.note: Most of the airflow is recirculation; the air handling unit supplies only the fresh air and the conditioning. Recovery time after a disturbance is the performance that is tested, not the airflow rate itself.

dryroom.label: Dry room — battery production
dryroom.note: A dew point down to −45 °C cannot be reached by cooling dehumidification: adsorption is mandatory. The real design question is the moisture ingress through airlocks, people and material — that determines the drying capacity, not the ventilation airflow rate. Separate extraction for NMP and electrolyte.
dryroom.basis: HIT 4A.16; adsorption drying and closed dry loop

koelhuis.label: Cold and freezer store
koelhuis.note: Infiltration through the doors is the dominant moisture and heat load. Ask for door cycles per hour, for the airlock arrangement and for the defrost regime — not for an air change rate.
koelhuis.basis: HIT 4A.18; EN 378 for the plant room

voeding_highcare.label: Food — high care
voeding_highcare.note: Cleanability comes before efficiency: no dead zones, full drainage, stainless steel construction, access for wet cleaning. Ask about the cleaning regime (wet/dry, frequency, agents) — that determines the choice of materials.

bakkerij.label: Industrial bakery
bakkerij.note: Flour dust on one side, vapour and heat from the ovens on the other. Treat the zones separately: a single air handling unit for the whole hall is almost always the wrong choice. Flour dust is moreover ATEX-relevant.
bakkerij.basis: HIT 4A — food industry, hot and humid lines

gieterij.label: Hot hall — foundry / glass / steel
gieterij.note: Thermal buoyancy does most of the work; the air handling unit delivers make-up air at working level. First calculate the natural extract and the neutral plane — a mechanical solution without that analysis is expensive and does not work.
gieterij.basis: HIT 4A.8; natural and hybrid ventilation of hot halls

lasserij.label: Welding / metalworking
lasserij.note: Source capture is primary; the air handling unit delivers make-up air. Recirculation of filtered welding fume is only permitted after demonstrated efficiency and with monitoring — set that down in the enquiry.

houtbewerking.label: Woodworking / furniture
houtbewerking.note: Wood dust is explosive. The extraction system with explosion isolation stands apart from the air handling unit, but the make-up air balance does not — state both airflow rates together.

lakstraat.label: Paint line / solvents
lakstraat.note: Full once-through principle, no recirculation, no heat recovery with any risk of carry-over. Reheat is needed because the paint temperature and RH are tightly bounded. ATEX zoning determines the specification of the fan and of the controls.

drukkerij.label: Printing / graphics
drukkerij.note: Paper is dimensionally stable only within a narrow RH band; static electricity builds up when the air is too dry. Solvent vapour calls for a separate assessment of recirculation and gas-phase filtration.

waterzuivering.label: Water treatment / biogas
waterzuivering.note: H₂S, methane and ammonia in a humid environment: stainless steel or coating, no recovery with carry-over, separate normal and emergency ventilation. Odour treatment of the extract is usually a permit condition.

stal.label: Livestock housing / grain storage
stal.note: Organic dust and ammonia foul exchangers very quickly. Grain dust is explosive. Ask for the cleaning interval — that determines whether an exchanger makes any sense at all.

datacenter.label: Data centre / technical room
datacenter.note: Availability comes before efficiency: N+1 on the fans and on the cooling, and a defined behaviour on power failure. Free cooling delivers the largest part of the saving here.

parking.label: Car park
parking.note: CO- and NOₓ-controlled ventilation in normal operation, smoke extract in fire mode. The fire mode determines the fan selection (temperature class) and sometimes the entire installation.
parking.basis: National car park guideline; EN 12101 where smoke control applies

industrie_algemeen.label: Industry — general
industrie_algemeen.note: Start with the process, not with the building: sources of heat, moisture, dust and vapour; operating states; and only then the air balance.
industrie_algemeen.basis: HIT 4A part I — general design method

ui.appSubtitle: The questions you have to ask in order to have an air handling unit selected
ui.tagline: From design assumptions to an enquiry a manufacturer can work with.
ui.intro: An air handling unit is assembled from modules. Which modules are needed does not follow from the casing but from the use of the space. This questionnaire works through that chain: every answer shows straight away what it changes about the composition, the duties and the risks.
ui.diagramEmpty: Fill in the questionnaire — the module sequence assembles itself here.
ui.diagramNote: The order shown is the usual arrangement. Every manufacturer has variants; use this schematic to check the enquiry, not as a construction drawing.
ui.checksNone: No findings with the current input.
ui.disclaimer: All calculated values on this sheet are design indications, intended to substantiate the enquiry and to make gross errors visible early. The final selection, the guaranteed performance, the acoustic data and the dimensions come from the manufacturer, from certified selection software and with project-specific verification. References to standards indicate where the requirement is to be found; always check the edition in force and the national provisions.
openQuestions: Performance data at the actual airflow rate, not at the nominal airflow rate of the unit.
Temperature efficiency and, where applicable, humidity efficiency, with the test standard stated.
Exhaust air transfer ratio (EATR) and outdoor air correction factor (OACF) of the heat recovery.
Sound power levels per octave band: supply, extract, outdoor air intake, discharge and casing breakout.
Internal pressure drop per section, with clean and with fouled filters.
EN 1886 classes as actually supplied, with the test report.
Dimensioned drawing with the free service space required on each side.
Mass per transport section and the position of the joints.
Points list of the controls with addresses and units.
Refrigerant charge per circuit and the resulting requirements for the room.
Maintenance instructions with replacement intervals and part numbers.

val.gewenst: is in fact wanted, for the moisture transfer
val.binnen: Indoor installation in a plant room

rotor_verboden.t: A rotary exchanger is not permissible here
rotor_verboden.d: A wheel always carries part of the extract air over into the supply — through the carrying matrix and through the gaps along the sectors. This application profile requires complete separation. Choose a counterflow plate heat exchanger with demonstrated leak-tightness, or a twin-coil where supply and extract also have to stay physically separated.

rotor_geen_spoel.d: Without a purge sector the carry-over from extract to supply rises sharply. Provide a purge sector and fix the pressure arrangement: the supply fan must draw relative to the extract, otherwise the purge sector works the wrong way round.

recirc_verboden.t: Recirculation is not permissible for this profile
recirc_verboden.d: The extract air contains contamination that must not come back into the supply. Recirculation can only be considered after demonstrably effective cleaning with continuous monitoring — and even then rarely. Work with a full once-through principle and recover heat with a system that keeps the media separated.

recirc_beperkt.d: For this profile recirculation is only acceptable with demonstrated cleaning efficiency and continuous monitoring. Fix the minimum fresh air proportion as a monitored value in the controls, not as a setting that anyone can change.

twincoil_goed.t: Twin-coil matches the requirement of complete separation
twincoil_goed.d: The efficiency is lower than with a plate exchanger or a wheel, but the media stay completely separated and supply and extract may be physically apart. Ask for the efficiency including pump energy — that is the honest basis for comparison.

erp_rendement.d: The requested temperature efficiency of {eta} % is below the minimum of {min} % that applies to this type. Raise the efficiency or substantiate why the unit falls outside the scope of the regulation.

epb_geen_wtw.t: No heat recovery on a project subject to energy performance requirements
epb_geen_wtw.d: Heat recovery is in principle mandatory on this type of project. Where the extract air rules out recovery with carry-over, a twin-coil is normally the accepted solution — not omitting the recovery.

sfp_te_hoog.t: Specific fan power above the stated limit
sfp_te_hoog.d: The estimate comes out at {sfp} W/(m³/s) against a limit of {limit}. The structural solution is a larger cross-section and a more generous duct system, not a different fan: pressure drop rises with the square of the velocity.

frontsnelheid.t: Face velocity too high for a wet coil
frontsnelheid.d: The calculated face velocity is {v} m/s. Above roughly {limit} m/s condensate droplets are carried off the cooling coil, even with a droplet eliminator. The result: wet ductwork, microbial growth and water damage. Increase the cross-section.
frontsnelheid.r: Practical limit for a wet cooling coil

frontsnelheid_laag.d: At {v} m/s the casing becomes unnecessarily large and expensive, and the air distribution over the coil may become uneven. Check that this size has been chosen deliberately.

vorst_geen_beveiliging.d: At {oda} °C outside the extract air leaves the exchanger at roughly {eha} °C. The exchanger will freeze up on the extract side. Choose a frost protection: modulating bypass, preheating, speed reduction or airflow reduction.
vorst_geen_beveiliging.r: HIT 4A — frost behaviour of heat recovery

vorst_debiet.d: Airflow reduction solves the frost problem at the expense of the ventilation, precisely when the space is closed up and the load is high. With a process, a pressure cascade or a hygienic application that is not acceptable.

vorst_voorverwarming.t: Preheating needed for the frost limit
vorst_voorverwarming.d: The outdoor air has to be preheated by roughly {dt} K to keep the exchanger free of frost; that amounts to roughly {kw} kW. Weigh this against a modulating bypass, which costs no energy but lowers the efficiency at the coldest moment.

condens_plaat.t: No condensate drainage on a plate heat exchanger
condens_plaat.d: On the extract side of a plate heat exchanger a considerable quantity of water condenses in winter. Without a drain tray with fall and a correctly calculated trap that water runs into the casing.

klep_veerretour.t: Dampers without spring return on a water coil
klep_veerretour.d: If the power fails while it is freezing outside, the outdoor air dampers stay open and the heating coil freezes. Spring return to the closed position is a safety requirement here, not a comfort option.

koudwater_te_warm.t: Chilled water temperature too high to dehumidify
koudwater_te_warm.d: With a flow temperature of {t} °C the surface temperature of the coil stays above the dew point of the air and virtually no dehumidification takes place. Real dehumidification requires 6–8 °C. This is a choice at system level: high-temperature cooling and deep dehumidification do not go together.

geen_naverwarming.d: To dehumidify, the air has to be cooled below the dew point; after that it is too cold to be supplied. Without a reheater an RH band cannot be met. Examine whether the reheat can come from recovered condenser heat instead of from the generation plant.

bevochtiging_hygiene.d: Evaporative and atomising systems require a management plan: water quality, flushing, dry-running regime during standstill and periodic checks. Set this down in the enquiry and in the maintenance contract, together with the responsibility for it.

adsorptie_nodig.d: A dew point of {td} °C is physically not attainable with cooling dehumidification. Below roughly −10 °C an adsorption dryer with regeneration is the only solution that works; in battery production it operates in a closed dry loop.

kast_isolatie.t: Casing insulation too light for outdoor installation
kast_isolatie.d: For outdoor installation class T3 or T4 gives substantial heat losses and condensation on the casing. Ask for T2 as a minimum, and T1 in a cold climate.

thermische_brug.d: With cooled or dehumidified air — and with outdoor installation in winter — condensation forms on profiles, hinges and bolted joints when the bridging class is too low. Ask for TB2 or better. This is not visible in the quotation, and very much so in the second year of operation.

hygiene_lekkage.d: A hygienic casing with leakage class L3 is a contradiction: unfiltered air comes in through the leaks and thereby bypasses the filtration. Ask for L1.

kust_corrosie.t: Coastal location without adapted corrosion protection
kust_corrosie.d: Salt aerosol attacks untreated aluminium and galvanised sheet within a few years, starting at the coil fins and the condensate trays. Ask for a coastal specification and pay explicit attention to the fins, not only to the casing.

zwembad_materiaal.t: Swimming pool air requires a chlorine-resistant construction
zwembad_materiaal.d: Chloramines rapidly attack aluminium, galvanised steel and many coatings. Ask for a construction expressly released for swimming pool air, including the coils, the condensate trays and the fixings.

transport_secties.d: The estimated length of {len} m will, at a maximum section length of {max} m, be delivered in roughly {n} parts. Fix who makes and seals the joints, and how the leakage class is demonstrated after assembly.

transport_doorgang.t: Unit does not fit through the access route
transport_doorgang.d: One transport section measures an estimated {w} × {h} m, while the smallest opening is {door} m. The unit has to be divided further or configured differently — taller and narrower, or in separate sections with assembly on site. Solve this before the order, not on the building site.

vloerbelasting.d: The estimated load is roughly {load} kg/m² against a permissible {max} kg/m². Provide a load-spreading structure or have the load-bearing capacity checked.

a2l.t: Flammable refrigerant ({refr}, group A2L) in the unit
a2l.d: Ask the manufacturer for the charge per circuit and for the corresponding minimum room size, leak detection and ventilation of the plant room. These requirements are part of what determines where the unit may stand and can rarely be resolved afterwards.

a3.d: R290 requires an explicit risk assessment, strict limits on the charge, leak detection and usually a separate ventilated plant room or an outdoor installation. Bring this in before the location is fixed, not after.

atex_ventilator.t: ATEX specification of fan and accessories
atex_ventilator.d: Within an ATEX zone the fan, motor, sensors and wiring must be certified for the zone and dust class concerned. Ask for the zoning document of the project and have the manufacturer confirm his specification against it.

filter_oda3.t: Filtration light for the stated outdoor air quality
filter_oda3.d: With ODA 3 a two-stage filtration with a final filter of at least ePM1 70 % is usual, often supplemented with gas-phase filtration. Also check where the outdoor air intake will be located: relocating it is generally more effective and cheaper than filtering more heavily.

geen_voorfilter.d: Without a pre-filter the fine filter loads up quickly and the heat recovery fouls, which cannot be cleaned. A pre-filter pays for itself within one filter life.

hepa_bypass.t: HEPA without a requirement on bypass leakage
hepa_bypass.d: Air that leaks past the filter instead of through it makes a HEPA pointless. Ask for EN 1886 class F9 and have the filter leak-tested in situ.

koolstof_contacttijd.t: Contact time of the gas-phase filter
koolstof_contacttijd.d: A gas-phase filter only works with sufficient residence time and with the right type of carbon for the substance concerned. Ask for the calculated service life at the actual concentration and for the replacement indication — a thin mat without substantiation does nothing.

regeling_gemengd.d: With a split supply the responsibility for the functioning lies nowhere clearly. Fix per function who supplies, who wires, who parameterises and who demonstrates the performance.

geen_vorstsequentie.d: A water coil calls for a frost protection with a sensor in the air stream and in the return water, a defined shutdown sequence and a pump overrun. Add this function to the list.

brandstand_inconsistent.t: Fire mode requested but not in the control functions
brandstand_inconsistent.d: Include the fire mode in the control functions and have the manufacturer describe the transitions. Conflicts between fire mode, frost protection and normal operation are a classic source of faults.

geen_meetrapport.t: No commissioning and measurement report requested
geen_meetrapport.d: Without a baseline measurement it cannot later be established whether the installation still delivers what was agreed, and any performance guarantee is unprovable.

geen_externe_druk.d: Without the pressure drop of the ductwork no fan whatsoever can be selected. This is the item that is missing most often and the most common cause of an installation that does not reach its airflow rate.

geen_debiet.d: Fill in the data on which the airflow rate is based, or state the airflow rate directly.

geen_sifon.d: The trap height has to suit the pressure at that point in the unit. On the suction side a trap that is too shallow draws air in through the drain and the condensate does not run away. Ask for calculated traps per drain point.

turndown.d: At {pct} % of the nominal airflow rate the air distribution, the heat recovery and the pressure control become unstable. Ask for the guaranteed control range of the fan and of the measuring section.

drukcascade_bewaking.d: A required positive or negative pressure that is not measured and monitored disappears in practice as soon as filters foul or doors open. Add pressure monitoring to the control functions.

akoestiek_geen_demper.t: Strict noise requirement without an attenuator
akoestiek_geen_demper.d: A requirement of {db} dB(A) is virtually unattainable without an attenuator. Reserve the casing length now — afterwards there is no room left.

geen_octaafband.d: Without sound power levels per octave band no acoustic calculation can be made and an attenuator cannot be sized. A single dB(A) value is insufficient for that.

profiel_note.t: Point of attention for this application profile

dak_niet_bevestigd.t: Load-bearing capacity of the roof not confirmed
dak_niet_bevestigd.d: The unit is estimated at {massa} kg on approximately {opp} m² of footprint, and that excludes water in the coils, snow and maintenance loading. Have a structural engineer confirm this in writing on the basis of the manufacturer's actual figures. In a refurbishment the original roof design is rarely calculated for this load. This is the only check on this sheet with a real safety risk — do not order before it is settled.
dak_niet_bevestigd.r: Structural verification by the structural engineer

geen_kraanplaats.t: Set-up area for the crane not established
geen_kraanplaats.d: A mobile crane needs a level, load-bearing surface for its outriggers and clear space around it. Check what lies beneath the set-up area — basement, parking deck, drainage — and whether there are overhead lines or trees in the path. Without a set-up area there is no placement day, however well the unit has been selected.

plaatsing_onbepaald.t: Method of placement not yet determined
plaatsing_onbepaald.d: As long as it is not settled how the unit is to reach its position, the split into transport sections is guesswork. Determine this before ordering: the manufacturer can match the split to the crane or the hoist, but not after the unit has been built.

collo_te_zwaar.t: Heaviest package above the stated limit
collo_te_zwaar.d: The heaviest part is estimated at {collo} kg against a limit of {max} kg. Have the manufacturer split it more finely, or provide heavier lifting equipment. Every additional joint is an additional risk of leakage, however — fix who seals it and how the leakage class is to be demonstrated after assembly.

dak_te_klein.d: Including service space, approximately {nodig} m² is required, against {vrij} m² available. Without that space filters and components cannot be withdrawn and maintenance is skipped in practice. Revise the arrangement or the position before the dimensions are fixed.

houten_dak.t: Heavy unit on a timber roof structure
houten_dak.d: Timber trusses call for careful load spreading and are sensitive to point loads and to vibration from the fans. Have the structure calculated including the dynamic loading, and provide a roof cradle that takes the load into the trusses, not into the roof boarding.

geen_hijsogen.t: No lifting eyes or lifting instruction requested
geen_hijsogen.d: Obtain the manufacturer's lifting instruction: attachment points, permissible sling angle, centre of gravity per section and whether a spreader beam is required. A unit that is slung incorrectly distorts and loses its leakage class — invisibly, until handover.

geen_windverankering.d: An externally sited unit is a large surface at a high point. Have the anchorage calculated for the local wind loading and make sure the forces are taken into the supporting structure, not into the roof covering.

dak_geen_toegang.t: No permanent access to the roof
dak_geen_toegang.d: Without a fixed stair or ladder and without collective fall protection, filters do not get changed and maintenance is put off. That determines whether the installation still delivers what was agreed after three years. Arrange as well how heavy material is to be got up there.

doorvoeren_onbepaald.d: Duct, pipe and cable penetrations break through the roof waterproofing and the vapour control layer. Fix who forms them, who makes them watertight and what that does to the roof warranty — it often lapses as soon as a third party works on the waterproofing.

vergunning_hijsdag.t: Permit for the placement day not yet arranged
vergunning_hijsdag.d: Street occupation, parking suspension or police authorisation carry a lead time of several weeks in many municipalities. That lead time governs the programme — often more strongly than the delivery time of the unit itself.

geen_opslag.d: Delivery and placement then have to fall on the same day. Plan that day with some margin and fix what happens in the event of delay: a unit that stands in the rain for weeks begins its life with moisture in the insulation and corrosion in the coils.

geen_vervangingsroute.d: In ten to fifteen years' time the exchanger, a coil or a fan module has to be able to come out. Ask the manufacturer which components are withdrawable and from which side, and keep that route clear. What is an empty strip now is later the difference between replacing a component and demolishing the whole unit.

route_onbekend.d: Measure the whole route: gateway, doorways, corridors, corners, lift, roof hatch. Pay particular attention to the corners — a 2.4 m section will not turn a 1.5 m corner, even though both dimensions fit on their own.

koeltoren_inlaat.t: Cooling tower in the vicinity of the outdoor air intake
koeltoren_inlaat.d: A cooling tower or evaporative condenser spreads water droplets that may contain legionella. That is not a filter matter: aerosols of that size pass through every air filter you could reasonably fit. Move the intake, or record in writing at what distance and in which direction it will sit relative to the plume. This is the cheapest intervention of the whole project as long as it happens on paper.

kortsluiting_inlaat.t: Intake and discharge too close together
kortsluiting_inlaat.d: At {d} m the installation draws part of its own exhaust air back in. The efficiency of the heat recovery then looks excellent while in reality too little fresh air is coming in — and that is precisely what you do not measure. Increase the distance or discharge vertically and unobstructed upwards.

inlaat_onbepaald.t: Position of the outdoor air intake not yet fixed
inlaat_onbepaald.d: The position of the intake determines the air quality more strongly than the filter class does. Fix the height, the façade and the orientation and test them against the emission sources in the vicinity, before the duct routes are drawn.

benedenwinds.t: Intake downwind of an emission source
benedenwinds.d: The prevailing wind carries the sources ticked to the intake all year round. Move the intake to the other façade or to a higher point; that works better and is cheaper than one filter class more.

spoor_nabij.d: Two independent consequences. Brake dust consists of fine iron particles and considerably increases the particulate loading on the intake — allow for a heavier final filtration. And vibration comes in through the structure; that is not solved by the air handling unit but by the installation arrangement, and it sometimes determines whether the unit may stand at that point at all.

verkeer_oda.t: Busy traffic artery but outdoor air quality not stated as ODA 3
verkeer_oda.d: Alongside a busy road ODA 3 is realistic. Revise the class or substantiate why ODA 2 is sufficient; the choice of filters depends directly on it.

geurbron_zonder_gasfilter.t: Odour or gas source nearby without gas-phase filtration
geurbron_zonder_gasfilter.d: Particulate filters do not stop gases or odours. Consider gas-phase filtration, or — better and cheaper — move the intake away from the source. With a carbon filter, always ask for the calculated service life at the actual concentration.

hoogspanning.d: For the placement: a crane must not come within the safety distance of a live line, and that distance is greater than most people estimate. Contact the network operator before the lifting day. For operation: induced interference on sensor and bus cables — ask for screened cabling and separate cable routes.

luchthaven_kraanhoogte.d: Within the obstacle limitation surfaces around an airport a height restriction applies and sometimes a separate authorisation for the crane. The lead time for that application mounts up; check this as soon as the method of placement is known.

overstroming.d: Determine the plinth height and the position of the electrical connections on the basis of the known water level, or site the unit higher. Motors and control panels that have stood under water once are replaced, not dried out.

sneeuw_roosters.t: Snow accumulation or falling ice at the external louvres
sneeuw_roosters.d: External louvres blocked with snow bring the installation to a standstill at the coldest moment of the year. Set the louvres well above roof level and allow for drifting snow, not only for the depth of the snow layer. Protect as well against ice falling from a higher roof.

geen_bliksem.t: Externally sited unit not in the lightning protection concept
geen_bliksem.d: A metal casing at the highest point of the building should be taken into the lightning protection and connected to the equipotential bonding. Fix who carries that out — it often falls between the electrician and the installer.

bouwfase_filters.t: Use during the building phase not arranged
bouwfase_filters.d: If the installation runs during the finishing works, the first set of filters loads up with construction dust and moisture gets into the ductwork. Agree whether it will run on construction-phase filters, who replaces them at handover, and who then inspects the ductwork.

mantel_te_licht.t: Casing construction too light for corrosivity category {cat}
mantel_te_licht.d: At {cat} galvanised steel or Aluzinc does not last long; the attack begins at cut edges, at the fasteners and at the transition to the coils. Ask for a coated construction or for stainless steel, and have the manufacturer justify his system against this category and against the required service life.

batterij_onbeschermd.d: Aluminium fins on copper tube are the standard construction and are not sufficient at {cat}. The fins are thin and have the largest surface area: that is where the damage begins, years before anything can be seen on the casing. Ask for an e-coat or an equivalent protection, including the contact zone between fin and tube.

lamel_niet_bestand.t: Fin material not resistant to the substances stated
lamel_niet_bestand.d: Aluminium is attacked by chlorine, ammonia, strong acids and alkalis, and by chlorides. Standard aluminium fins on copper tube are the wrong choice here. Choose an e-coat, a fully stainless steel construction or one matched to the substance, and have the manufacturer confirm the combination of materials against the substances stated — not against "industrial environment".

koper_ammoniak.t: Copper in combination with ammonia or sulphur compounds
koper_ammoniak.d: Copper and copper alloys are attacked by ammonia and by sulphur compounds; with ammonia stress corrosion cracking also occurs in the tube wall. Discuss a stainless steel construction or an adapted alloy, including for the connections and the brazed joints.

rvs304_chloride.t: Stainless steel 304 in a chloride-rich environment
rvs304_chloride.d: Chlorine-based cleaning and disinfection agents, sea salt and brine cause pitting and stress corrosion cracking in 304. Ask for 316L. The difference is small on the quotation and decisive in the third year of operation.

bevestiging_a4.d: At {cat} and in any chlorine-bearing environment A4 is the lower limit. Stainless panels on galvanised bolts moreover give galvanic corrosion: the bolt goes first, and after that the panel joint works loose — with loss of the leakage class as a result.

strooizout.t: Road de-icing salt without a raised corrosivity category
strooizout.d: De-icing salt spray is chemically the same problem as sea salt and is structurally overlooked, even far from the coast. Consider category C4 for the parts that catch the spray, and pay particular attention to an intake at ground level alongside a salted road.

condensbak_verzinkt.t: Galvanised condensate tray with persistent wet operation
condensbak_verzinkt.d: The condensate tray stands permanently in water in which everything the air brings with it dissolves. Galvanised trays are the most common early failure in an air handling unit. Ask for stainless steel — 316L where there are chlorides — and full fall to the drain point; a tray without fall is a breeding ground, whatever the material.

abrasief_rotor.d: Mineral and metal-bearing dust particles wear the matrix and the sealing brushes of a wheel, so that the carry-over increases and the efficiency drops. Provide a heavier pre-filtration on the extract side, or choose an exchanger that can be cleaned.

kust_categorie.t: Coastal location but corrosivity assessed as low
kust_categorie.d: Within a few kilometres of the coast C4 is realistic, and on the front line C5. Raise the category or substantiate the lower assessment; every choice of material on this sheet depends on it.

atex_inconsistent.t: ATEX indicated but no zone stated
atex_inconsistent.d: ATEX has been ticked under the standards, but this block states no explosion risk. Bring one of the two up to date: without a zone the manufacturer cannot offer a compliant construction, and with a zone a standard construction is not permitted.

geen_zoneringsdocument.t: No zoning plan or explosion protection document
geen_zoneringsdocument.d: Without a zoning document no manufacturer can offer a compliant construction and afterwards nobody can demonstrate compliance. This document is the responsibility of the employer or operator and must exist before the enquiry goes out. Obtain it — this is not a formality but the basis of the entire construction.

ventilator_niet_atex.d: In a zone in the air stream the fan must be of spark-reduced construction to EN 14986: a controlled combination of materials between impeller, housing and inlet cone, sufficient clearance and an earthed shaft. Note — a spark-reduced impeller in an ordinary housing is not spark-reduced. Consider as well placing the fan outside the zone; that is often simpler and always easier to maintain.

filter_statisch.t: No antistatic construction within a zone
filter_statisch.d: Filter media, seals and flexible connections build up a static charge and then become an ignition source in their own right. Within a zone they should be conductive and bonded through to the earthing. This is almost always forgotten because a filter is seen as a passive component.

geen_equipotentiaal.d: Casing, ductwork, flexible connections, filter frames and the dust extraction ducting must be bonded through and earthed, with a measurable contact resistance. Include this as a handover point with measured values, not as a construction detail.

elektrische_batterij_zone.t: Electric heating coil within a zone
elektrische_batterij_zone.d: An electric element in an explosive atmosphere is an ignition source with a surface temperature that cannot be guaranteed under fault conditions. Choose a water coil, or bring the heating outside the zone.

rotor_in_zone.d: A wheel brings moving parts, brush seals and a drive into the air stream, plus carry-over between the two air streams — and therefore transfer of the explosive atmosphere to the supply side. Within a zone this is rarely acceptable; a twin-coil keeps the media completely separated.

stofgegevens_ontbreken.d: Without the name of the substance, the lower explosive limit and — for dust — the minimum ignition temperature of cloud and layer and the Kst value, the temperature class cannot be determined and the venting cannot be calculated. These figures come from the safety data sheet or from a test, not from an estimate.

geen_ontkoppeling.d: A dust extraction system with a filter or a cyclone requires explosion venting to a safe place and isolation, so that an explosion does not propagate along the ducting into the workspace. This stands apart from the air handling unit, but the air balance and the make-up air do not — state both together.

zone_0_20.t: Zone 0 or 20 in the air stream
zone_0_20.d: A continuously present explosive atmosphere in the air stream calls for equipment category 1 and is in practice not a workable starting point for an ordinary air handling unit. First examine whether the zone can be reduced by extracting at the source more effectively or by enclosing it; that is almost always the cheaper and the safer route.

klep.w: Closes the unit off at standstill and protects the coils against frost.

mengsectie.w: Recirculation up to {pct} % lowers the energy consumption outside occupancy hours.
mengsectie.d: The minimum fresh air proportion is monitored by the controls, not set.

voorfilter.w: Protects the heat recovery and the final filter and extends the life of the most expensive filter stage.
voorfilter.d: Class {klasse}, chosen for outdoor air quality {oda}.

voorverwarmer.w: Keeps the exchanger free of frost at {oda} °C outside, without loss of efficiency.
voorverwarmer.d: Required temperature rise {dt} K; estimated duty {kw} kW.

wtw.w: A {type} was chosen because carry-over between extract and supply here {overdracht}.
wtw.d: Temperature efficiency {eta} %, humidity efficiency {etax} %; roughly {kwh} kWh recovered annually.

koeler_nat.w: Cools and dehumidifies: the air is brought below the dew point in order to meet the upper humidity limit.
koeler_nat.d: Estimated {kw} kW total, of which {kws} kW sensible and {kwl} kW latent; condensate {cond} kg/h; regime {tin}/{tout} °C; face velocity {v} m/s.
koeler_nat.n: Face velocity limit for a wet coil

koeler_droog.d: Estimated {kw} kW; regime {tin}/{tout} °C; face velocity {v} m/s.

verwarmer.w: Brings the air up to the required supply temperature after the heat recovery.
verwarmer.d: Estimated {kw} kW; medium {medium}, regime {tin}/{tout} °C. With a low-temperature regime the coil is considerably larger than with a boiler regime.

bevochtiger.w: Maintains the lower limit of {rh} % RH in winter.
bevochtiger.d: Estimated water demand {kg} kg/h, duty {kw} kW; type {type}.

ventilator.d: Estimated total absorbed power {kw} kW; SFP {sfp} W/(m³/s) at {dp} Pa total supply pressure drop, of which {esp} Pa external.

naverwarmer.w: Brings the dehumidified air back up to supply temperature.
naverwarmer.d: Estimated {kw} kW. Examine whether condenser heat can be used for this.

eindfilter.w: Determines the air quality delivered into the space.
eindfilter.d: Class {klasse}; the final pressure drop of {dp} Pa has been included in the fan selection.

hepa.w: Final filtration for the required cleanliness class.
hepa.d: Class {klasse}, with in-situ leak test and bypass leakage to EN 1886 class F9.

demper.w: Needed in order to reach {db} dB(A) in the space.
demper.d: Sizing on the manufacturer's octave band data; reserve 0.9–1.5 m of casing length per attenuator.

kast.d: EN 1886: {d} / {l} / {f} / {t} / {tb}. Corrosion specification: {corrosie}. Estimated dimensions {w} × {h} × {len} m, mass roughly {massa} kg.

project.title: Project and application
project.intro: Where is the installation located, what happens in the space and who decides? The application profile drives the rest of the questionnaire: it determines which modules are permissible at all.

condities.title: Outdoor and indoor conditions
condities.intro: The two extreme design points. Everything that comes after — capacities, frost protection, dehumidification — follows from these. Obtain these values; do not assume them.

debiet.title: Airflow rate and balance
debiet.intro: The airflow rate follows from the reason for ventilating. Establish that reason first — people, floor area, process or thermal load — and only then calculate. An airflow rate chosen by feel is the most expensive mistake in the entire project.

behandeling.title: Air treatment
behandeling.intro: Which treatment processes must the air undergo? Every process means a module, extra length, extra pressure drop and extra maintenance. Ask each time: is this genuinely a requirement, or just habit?

wtw.title: Heat recovery
wtw.intro: The module with the greatest impact on energy and the most pitfalls. The main question is not "what efficiency", but "is transfer between extract and supply permitted" — the answer to that rules out entire types.

batterijen.title: Coils and energy generation
batterijen.intro: This is where the heat pump you can already specify comes in. The difference from a stand-alone installation is that the temperature regimes of the coil and of the generator have to match one another — otherwise neither achieves its stated performance.

filters.title: Filtration
filters.intro: Since ISO 16890, filter classes have been expressed as the efficiency against a particle fraction, no longer as F and G classes. An old F7 corresponds roughly to ePM1 50–60 %, but a one-to-one conversion is not possible.

ventilatoren.title: Fans
ventilatoren.intro: Without the external pressure drop of the ductwork nobody can select a fan. This is the item most often missing from an enquiry and the most frequent cause of an installation that fails to achieve its airflow rate.

kast.title: Casing, installation and transport
kast.intro: The classes in EN 1886 are the only objective measure of the build quality of the casing. Specify them explicitly — without that requirement every manufacturer supplies its own basic build and the quotations cannot be compared.

secties.title: Sections, dampers and accessories
secties.intro: The items that are rarely in an enquiry and always turn out to be needed. Each of them costs length: include them now, not after the casing dimensions have been fixed.

regeling.title: Controls and integration
regeling.intro: Who supplies the control system determines who is responsible for how it performs. A factory-fitted control system is proven and quick to bring into operation; a field control system integrates better with the building management system. Choose one of the two and define the interface.

akoestiek.title: Acoustics
akoestiek.intro: Noise is rarely mentioned at enquiry stage and is the most expensive thing to put right after handover. Request the sound power levels per octave band — a single dB(A) figure says too little to size an attenuator with.

oplevering.title: Standards, handover and management
oplevering.intro: What you set down here determines whether the installation still does what it should after five years. It is also the part of the specification that is most easily left out and the most expensive to miss.

levering.title: Delivery, craning and placement
levering.intro: These questions are not about the unit but about whether it will ever reach its position. They are almost never asked at enquiry stage and are the most common reason for a project to run late or become more expensive — after everything has already been ordered. A unit that cannot be placed is no longer a technical problem but a site problem.

omgeving.title: Surroundings and siting
omgeving.intro: Where the outdoor air intake ends up determines the air quality more strongly than any filter does. Moving an intake costs almost nothing as long as it happens on paper. These questions are also about what the surroundings do to the installation: vibration, corrosion, interference, snow, water and access.

materialen.title: Corrosion, materials and explosion protection
materialen.intro: Corrosion has two independent sides: what comes at the casing from outside, and what flows through the unit inside. They call for different answers and different materials. The parts that fail first are never the casing, but the fins, the condensate trays and the fasteners.

prj_name.label: Project name
prj_name.help: Appears in the header of the specification and of the report.

prj_client.label: Client
prj_client.help: Who signs off the requirements? Where a contractor acts as intermediary: also record the end user, because it is the end user who sets the requirements for comfort and maintenance.

prj_location.label: Location / address
prj_location.help: Determines the design outdoor conditions, the distance to the coast (salt loading) and the applicable environmental conditions for noise emitted to the surroundings.

prj_ref.label: Reference / file number
prj_ref.help: Your own reference, so that the quotation and the specification can be linked to each other.

prj_author.label: Prepared by
prj_author.help: Contact person for technical queries from the manufacturer.

prj_unit_tag.label: Air handling unit tag
prj_unit_tag.help: For example AHU-01. Where a project contains several units, this is the key by which everything is traced back.

prj_type.label: Nature of the project
prj_type.help: In a replacement project the existing situation is the most severe constraint: the delivery route, the foundation, the duct connections and the available height are already fixed.

prj_profile.label: Application profile
prj_profile.help: The most important question in the whole list. The profile determines whether recirculation is allowed, whether a rotary heat exchanger is permissible, which hygiene requirements apply and in which material specification the unit has to be built. Choose the profile closest to the actual process, not the profile that is easiest.

prj_process_desc.label: Description of the process or use
prj_process_desc.help: What actually happens in the space? Which substances are released, when, and in which operating states? This is the information on which the manufacturer either enters or drops its reservations.

prj_epb.label: Does the project fall under the energy performance regulations?
prj_epb.help: If so, the minimum heat recovery efficiency, the maximum specific fan power and the metering and control requirements are laid down in law and are not a point for negotiation.

prj_count.label: Number of identical air handling units
prj_count.help: Determines batch size and lead time, and sometimes the pricing.

cnd_oda_t_w.label: Design outdoor temperature, winter
cnd_oda_t_w.help: Governing for the heating coil and for the frost risk of the heat recovery. For Belgium, depending on the zone and the building mass, −8 to −11 °C is generally used; verify the value for your location.

cnd_oda_rh_w.label: Outdoor relative humidity, winter
cnd_oda_rh_w.help: At low temperatures air contains little moisture, even at high RH. This value determines how much humidification is needed if a lower limit for the indoor humidity applies.

cnd_oda_t_s.label: Design outdoor temperature, summer
cnd_oda_t_s.help: Governing for the cooling coil. Note: for the latent load the wet-bulb temperature is more important than the dry-bulb temperature.

cnd_oda_rh_s.label: Outdoor relative humidity, summer
cnd_oda_rh_s.help: Together with the summer temperature this determines the moisture content of the outdoor air and therefore the latent share of the cooling load. Underestimating it is the most common reason for a cooling coil falling short in practice.

cnd_altitude.label: Altitude above sea level
cnd_altitude.help: Affects the air density and with it all capacities. Below roughly 300 m the effect is negligible.

cnd_coastal.label: Located within 5 km of the coast or of salt water?
cnd_coastal.help: Salt aerosol attacks aluminium fins and galvanised sheet rapidly. If so, a coated coil or a stainless steel build is not a luxury but a service-life requirement.

cnd_oda_class.label: Outdoor air quality (ODA class)
cnd_oda_class.help: In accordance with EN 16798-3. Together with the required indoor air quality this determines the filter classes. Alongside a busy traffic route, an industrial area or a nearby emission source, ODA 3 is realistic — also consider where the outdoor air intake is placed relative to the discharge and to external sources.

options.ODA2: ODA 2 — high concentration of particulate matter or gases

cnd_category.label: Comfort category EN 16798-1
cnd_category.help: Determines the design temperature band and the ventilation rate per person. Category I costs considerably more airflow and therefore more capacity — agree this explicitly.

cnd_ida_t_w.label: Room temperature, winter
cnd_ida_t_w.help: Also the temperature of the return air and therefore of the warm side of the heat recovery.

cnd_ida_rh_w.label: Room RH, winter (expected)
cnd_ida_rh_w.help: Used to determine the moisture content of the extract air, which governs the frost risk of the exchanger and the yield of a moisture-transferring thermal wheel.

cnd_ida_t_s.label: Room temperature, summer
cnd_ida_t_s.help: Determines the cooling load and the point at which free cooling becomes worthwhile.

cnd_ida_rh_s.label: Room RH, summer (expected)
cnd_ida_rh_s.help: Together with the room temperature, the reference point for the extract air in summer.

cnd_rh_control.label: Is the humidity controlled?
cnd_rh_control.help: This is the question that is most often skipped and the most expensive to put right afterwards. Full control requires humidification, deep cooling and reheat — three extra modules, extra length, extra energy.

cnd_ida_rh_min.label: Minimum RH
cnd_ida_rh_min.help: Determines the humidification capacity. Every percentage point lower than strictly necessary saves considerably in energy and in maintenance.

cnd_ida_rh_max.label: Maximum RH
cnd_ida_rh_max.help: Determines how deeply the cooling coil has to dehumidify and whether reheat is needed.

cnd_rh_tolerance.label: Permitted deviation on the RH
cnd_rh_tolerance.help: A band of ±5 % is normally achievable; ±2 % calls for a different control strategy and usually for dew point control with reheat per zone.

cnd_dewpoint_target.label: Required room dew point
cnd_dewpoint_target.help: Below roughly +4 °C dew point, cooling-based drying is no longer economic and below roughly −10 °C it is no longer physically achievable: adsorption drying is then required. State the dew point, not the RH — at low values RH is an unusable quantity.

cnd_zones.label: Number of zones served by this air handling unit
cnd_zones.help: Several zones with different requirements on one unit means terminal control per zone. The unit then supplies neutral air and part of the capacity shifts to the terminal units.

flw_basis.label: What is the airflow rate based on?
flw_basis.help: Air change rate is the weakest basis: it says nothing about the actual load. Use it only where the process offers no other measure. In an all-air system the thermal load is governing and the hygienic airflow rate is merely a lower limit.

flw_persons.label: Number of people
flw_persons.help: Design occupancy, not average occupancy. Also ask about the peak occupancy and whether it occurs simultaneously in all zones.

flw_q_person.label: Airflow rate per person
flw_q_person.help: EN 16798-1 gives, depending on the category and the building emissions, roughly 22 to 50 m³/h per person. Check which value your national regulations impose — that value is binding.

flw_q_area.label: Airflow rate per m²
flw_q_area.help: For offices this is around 3.6 m³/h·m²; for shops and hospitality considerably higher.

flw_ach.label: Air change rate
flw_ach.help: For cleanrooms and operating theatres this is indeed the correct measure, because the requirement there is based on dilution and recovery time.

flw_process_extract.label: Stated airflow rate
flw_process_extract.help: For process extract: the sum of all extract points in the governing operating state, not the sum of all extract points that are present.

flw_q_sens.label: Sensible heat load
flw_q_sens.help: Net sensible load to be removed in the governing state: people, lighting, equipment, solar gain and transmission.

flw_dt_supply.label: Permitted supply temperature difference
flw_dt_supply.help: Limited by the supply air arrangement and by the draught risk. A larger difference means less airflow and therefore a smaller unit, but requires a supply air system that can cope with it.

flw_supply_override.label: Supply airflow rate — manual value
flw_supply_override.help: Only complete this if you wish to override the calculated airflow rate, for example because it comes from an earlier study.

flw_extract_override.label: Extract airflow rate — manual value
flw_extract_override.help: Only complete this if the extract airflow rate is independent of the selected balance.

flw_balance.label: Required air balance
flw_balance.help: The pressure hierarchy protects either the product or the surroundings. Clean processes are held at positive pressure, contaminating and hazardous processes at negative pressure. This is a design decision that you do not leave to the commissioning engineer.

flw_unbalance_pct.label: Imbalance
flw_unbalance_pct.help: The airflow difference that has to escape via gaps, airlocks and transfer grilles. Without a defined transfer path this is never achieved.

flw_dp_room.label: Required pressure difference with the adjacent zone
flw_dp_room.help: Practical range 5–20 Pa. More than 25 Pa makes doors heavy and airlocks unworkable.

flw_variable.label: Variable airflow rate?
flw_variable.help: Variable airflow greatly reduces the annual consumption, but places demands on the fan control, on the measuring sections and on the stability of the pressure hierarchy at part load.

options.co2: Demand controlled on CO₂ or occupancy

flw_min_pct.label: Minimum airflow rate
flw_min_pct.help: Below roughly 30 % the air distribution, the heat recovery and the pressure control become unstable. Check the guaranteed control range with the manufacturer.

flw_hours.label: Operating hours per year
flw_hours.help: Determines the payback time of a higher efficiency and of filters with a lower pressure drop.

air_heat.label: Heating?
air_heat.help: Almost always yes, if only to bring the supply air up to room temperature after the heat recovery.

air_cool.label: Cooling?
air_cool.help: Without cooling the supply temperature follows the outdoor temperature in summer. For a hygienic ventilation installation that may be acceptable; for an all-air system it is not.

air_dehum.label: Dehumidification?
air_dehum.help: Dehumidification requires a lower chilled water temperature and usually reheat. This is the principal cost driver on the cooling side.

air_humid.label: Humidification?
air_humid.help: Steam is isothermal, the simplest hygienically and the most expensive in energy terms. Adiabatic systems cool at the same time and consume far less, but require a water treatment and management plan against legionella. Choose deliberately — this is not a detail of the build.

air_reheat.label: Reheat after dehumidification?
air_reheat.help: Where deep cooling is used to dehumidify, the air is too cold to be supplied. Without reheat, tight RH control is not possible. First examine whether the reheat can come from recovered heat instead of from the boiler.

air_t_sup_w.label: Required supply temperature, winter
air_t_sup_w.help: Supplying air above room level sharply reduces the ventilation effectiveness: warm air stays up at the ceiling. Above roughly 3 K over room temperature that is a real problem.

air_t_sup_s.label: Required supply temperature, summer
air_t_sup_s.help: The lower limit follows from the draught risk and from the supply air system. Below 14 °C, condensation on grilles and ducts is a point of attention.

air_rh_leave.label: Maximum RH after the cooling coil
air_rh_leave.help: Air leaves a wet coil virtually saturated. This value determines the calculated latent capacity; 90–95 % is realistic.

air_ctrl_strategy.label: Control strategy for the supply temperature
air_ctrl_strategy.help: Determines which sensors are located where and how many control loops the manufacturer has to supply. Dew point control is the only one that achieves a tight RH band, but it consumes structurally more energy.

wtw_needed.label: Apply heat recovery?
wtw_needed.help: For buildings subject to the energy performance regulations this is a legal requirement. Only for demonstrably hazardous or heavily contaminated extract air may it be departed from — and then still often with a run-around coil.

wtw_crosscontam.label: Is transfer between extract and supply air permissible?
wtw_crosscontam.help: This is the pivotal question. Full separation rules out rotary heat exchangers and forces the choice towards a plate heat exchanger in a leaktight build or towards a run-around coil. For kitchens, laboratories, swimming pools, healthcare and most processes, separation is not negotiable.

options.gewenst: Moisture transfer is in fact wanted

wtw_type.label: Type of exchanger
wtw_type.help: Counterflow plates achieve the highest sensible efficiency with full separation, but are frost-sensitive and large. Thermal wheels are compact and have the least frost problem, but always transfer something. A run-around coil has the lowest efficiency but separates completely and allows supply and extract to be placed physically apart.

wtw_eta.label: Required temperature efficiency
wtw_eta.help: Ecodesign (EU 1253/2014) has required since 2018 a minimum of 73 % for regenerative and 68 % for recuperative systems, measured at balanced airflow and under dry conditions. Ask for the efficiency at your airflow rate, not at the nominal airflow rate of the exchanger.

wtw_eta_x.label: Required moisture efficiency
wtw_eta_x.help: Only sorption wheels transfer moisture at low outdoor temperatures. That greatly reduces the humidification demand and virtually eliminates the frost problem.

wtw_bypass.label: Bypass for free cooling?
wtw_bypass.help: Without a bypass the exchanger reheats the cool outdoor air on a summer night and free cooling is lost. On a thermal wheel this is done by speed control, on plates by a damper bypass.

wtw_frost.label: Frost protection
wtw_frost.help: On a counterflow plate exchanger, ice formation already occurs at around −3 to −5 °C outdoors. A modulating bypass is the most favourable in energy terms but reduces the efficiency precisely when it is needed most; a preheater costs energy but keeps the efficiency up. Airflow reduction is rarely acceptable where there is a process.

options.toeren: Speed reduction of the thermal wheel

wtw_frost_limit.label: Frost limit on the extract side
wtw_frost_limit.help: The temperature at which the extract side begins to freeze up. For dry extract air this lies lower than for humid air. Used to determine the preheating required.

wtw_leakage.label: Required leaktightness of the exchanger
wtw_leakage.help: Ask for the measured exhaust air transfer ratio (EATR) and the outdoor air correction factor (OACF), not for "practically leak-free". On a thermal wheel without a purge sector and without the correct pressure relationship, the transfer can rise to several per cent of the airflow rate.

options.en308: Demonstrated in accordance with EN 308 (OACF / EATR)

wtw_purge.label: Purge sector on the thermal wheel?
wtw_purge.help: A purge sector greatly reduces the transfer, but only works with the correct relative pressures: the supply fan must draw through relative to the extract. Set that pressure arrangement out in the specification.

wtw_condensate.label: Condensate drainage provided on the extract side?
wtw_condensate.help: In a plate heat exchanger the extract air condenses in winter. Without correct collection and a trap, that water runs into the casing.

bat_heat_medium.label: Heating coil medium
bat_heat_medium.help: With a heat pump as the source the flow regime is low; the coil is then considerably larger than with a boiler. A coil selected for 70/50 delivers roughly half at 45/40.

options.wp_condensor: Heat pump — condenser in the unit (DX)

bat_heat_tin.label: Heating flow temperature
bat_heat_tin.help: State the actual design regime, not the regime of the boiler at full load. With a heat pump this is often 40–50 °C.

bat_heat_tout.label: Heating return temperature
bat_heat_tout.help: A large temperature difference lowers the water flow rate and improves the efficiency of a heat pump; a small difference calls for a larger coil.

bat_heat_glycol_pct.label: Glycol percentage
bat_heat_glycol_pct.help: Glycol reduces the heat transfer and increases the pressure drop. At 30 % the capacity derating is roughly 5–8 %; have the manufacturer calculate with the actual mixture.

bat_cool_medium.label: Cooling coil medium
bat_cool_medium.help: DX inside the unit makes the installation compact but ties the air handling unit to a single supplier and brings refrigerant into the building — with the obligations that go with it.

bat_cool_tin.label: Cooling flow temperature
bat_cool_tin.help: For dehumidification 6–8 °C is needed. If you wish to work with a high-temperature chiller or with free cooling (12–18 °C), deep dehumidification is no longer possible — that is a system choice, not a coil choice.

bat_cool_refr.label: Refrigerant
bat_cool_refr.help: A2L and A3 are flammable. That brings requirements from EN 378 and the F-gas Regulation: maximum charge per room, leak detection, ventilation of the plant room and sometimes a separate plant room. Ask the manufacturer for the charge quantity before you fix the installation location.

bat_wp_integrated.label: Integrated heat pump?
bat_wp_integrated.help: A heat pump on the extract air works downstream of the heat recovery and takes the residual heat out of it. That is attractive in energy terms but places the exchanger and the heat pump in series on the same source — have both calculated through by one party, otherwise everyone counts the same energy twice.

options.wtw_wp: Heat pump on the extract air

bat_defrost.label: Defrosting of the outdoor coil
bat_defrost.help: During defrosting the heat pump delivers no heat and sometimes even cooling. Ask how the supply temperature is monitored at that moment and whether a reheater is needed to stop the room from dropping away.

bat_face_vel_target.label: Target face velocity
bat_face_vel_target.help: The most important sizing parameter of the whole unit. Around 2.0–2.5 m/s lies the optimum between casing size and pressure drop. Above 2.7 m/s across a wet cooling coil, water droplets are carried over, even with a droplet eliminator.

bat_droplet.label: Droplet eliminator after the cooling coil?
bat_droplet.help: Mandatory as soon as the coil dehumidifies. It costs pressure drop, but the alternatives — wet ductwork and microbial growth — are worse.

bat_dp_max.label: Maximum waterside pressure drop
bat_dp_max.help: Limits the pump energy. At low temperature regimes the water flow rate rises and with it the pressure drop, quadratically — state the limit explicitly.

bat_drain.label: Coils fully drainable and flushable?
bat_drain.help: Needed where there is a frost risk and for maintenance. Ask about the position of the drain and vent points, not only about their presence.

flt_sup_pre.label: Supply pre-filter
flt_sup_pre.help: Protects the exchanger and the final filter. Without a pre-filter the heat recovery becomes fouled, and that cannot be cleaned, or barely.

flt_sup_fin.label: Supply final filter
flt_sup_fin.help: Determines the air quality delivered. EN 16798-3 links this to the ODA class and to the required indoor air class; at ODA 2 with normal indoor air, ePM1 ≥ 50 % is the usual minimum.

flt_ext.label: Extract side filter
flt_ext.help: Protects the exchanger against fouling coming from the space. In a kitchen or a dusty process this is the module that blocks up fastest — ask about its accessibility.

flt_hepa.label: HEPA filter
flt_hepa.help: If a HEPA filter is needed, it belongs as close as possible to the space — usually in the ceiling, not in the unit. If it is nevertheless placed in the unit, agree who leak-tests it in situ and by which method.

flt_carbon.label: Gas-phase or carbon filter?
flt_carbon.help: For odour, solvents, exhaust gases or aggressive gases. It only works with sufficient contact time: a thin carbon mat is token treatment. Ask about the service life at the actual concentration.

flt_depth.label: Filter construction
flt_depth.help: Bag filters have a longer service life and a lower pressure drop per m², compact filters are shorter. The choice influences the casing length and the maintenance budget over the service life more than the purchase price does.

flt_dp_final.label: Final pressure drop per filter stage
flt_dp_final.help: The pressure drop at which the filter is replaced. This value belongs in the fan selection, otherwise the installation no longer achieves the airflow rate at the end of the service life.

flt_energy_class.label: Energy class of the filter
flt_energy_class.help: Over its service life the filter is often the largest item in the energy consumption of the unit. One class higher usually pays for itself within a single service life.

flt_monitor.label: Monitoring of filter fouling
flt_monitor.help: A transmitter makes replacement on actual fouling possible instead of on the calendar. That saves filters and energy, and provides the evidence for the maintenance reporting.

flt_access.label: Access for filter replacement
flt_access.help: A practical question with major consequences: if there is no room to withdraw the filter, it will not be replaced. Check the clear space alongside the unit before ordering.

flt_bypass_class.label: Filter bypass leakage
flt_bypass_class.help: Air that leaks past the filter instead of through it makes the filter class meaningless. At high filter classes, F9 is a necessary additional requirement.

fan_esp_sup.label: External pressure drop of the supply ductwork
fan_esp_sup.help: The complete ductwork from the unit up to and including the grilles, including fire dampers, control dampers and terminal units. If in doubt: have it calculated. A margin of 20 % on a measured value is sensible; a margin on a guessed value is not.

fan_esp_ext.label: External pressure drop of the extract ductwork
fan_esp_ext.help: The same for the extract side, including the external louvre and the discharge.

fan_type.label: Type of fan
fan_type.help: A fan wall gives redundancy, a flatter efficiency curve at part load and a short unit, but more control complexity. Belt drive is now really only worthwhile at very high pressures or at unusual temperatures.

fan_redundancy.label: Redundancy
fan_redundancy.help: Ask what has to happen on failure: may the installation stop, or must a reduced airflow rate be maintained? For a data centre, an operating theatre or a process zone that is a hard requirement.

fan_control.label: Control of the fan
fan_control.help: Constant airflow rate compensates automatically for filter fouling; constant pressure is needed with VAV. The choice determines which measuring sections and sensors the unit has to contain.

fan_efficiency.label: Overall fan efficiency to be assumed
fan_efficiency.help: Impeller, motor and control together. For a good EC plug fan 0.60–0.70. Used only for the indicative power calculation on this sheet.

fan_sfp_limit.label: Maximum specific fan power (SFP)
fan_sfp_limit.help: Note which of the three definitions your specification means. Per air stream: the power input of one fan divided by its own airflow rate — that is the value this sheet compares against. Per system: both fans together divided by the larger airflow rate, so roughly double. SFPint from the Ecodesign Regulation counts only the pressure drop inside the unit, without the ductwork. A low SFP comes mainly from a generous cross-section and generous ductwork, not from a different fan.

fan_power_supply.label: Supply voltage
fan_power_supply.help: Also state who provides the electrical supply up to the unit and whether an isolator is required per fan.

fan_softstart.label: Is limitation of the starting current required?
fan_softstart.help: Relevant where the connected load is limited or where there is a standby generator. EC fans generally already have a soft start.

cas_location.label: Installation location
cas_location.help: Outdoor installation calls for a roof, watertight penetrations, frost protection of all waterside parts and a considerably better thermal casing class. For a roof installation: check the load-bearing capacity and the access before making the choice.

cas_arrangement.label: Arrangement
cas_arrangement.help: Stacked halves the floor area but doubles the height and makes maintenance of the upper sections more difficult. Separate units are needed where supply and extract have to lie physically apart — a run-around coil is then the only recovery option.

options.naast: Supply and extract side by side

cas_class_d.label: Mechanical strength (EN 1886)
cas_class_d.help: Determines the deflection of the panel at operating pressure. At high pressures or with large units, D1 is needed to prevent panels from flexing and losing their airtightness.

cas_class_l.label: Air leakage of the casing (EN 1886)
cas_class_l.help: Leakage is lost energy and, under negative pressure, unfiltered air entering the casing. With high filter classes, hygienic applications or pressure cascades, L1 is required.

cas_class_t.label: Thermal transmittance of the panel (EN 1886)
cas_class_t.help: Determines the heat loss and, together with the thermal bridging, the risk of condensation on the outside of the casing.

cas_class_tb.label: Thermal bridging (EN 1886)
cas_class_tb.help: An underestimated criterion. With a cold unit in a warm room, or an outdoor installation in winter, condensation forms on the profiles and on the bolted joints if the bridging class is too low. Where there is cooling with dehumidification, TB2 is the practical minimum.

cas_hygiene.label: Hygiene requirement
cas_hygiene.help: A hygienic build means smooth internal surfaces, no exposed insulation, no dead zones, full drainage of every wet section and access to every surface. That is a construction principle, not an option you add later.

cas_corrosion.label: Corrosion protection
cas_corrosion.help: Ask separately about the specification of the coil fins and of the condensate trays: those are the parts that rust through first, not the casing shell.

cas_face_w.label: Maximum casing width
cas_face_w.help: Leave blank to let the width follow from the face velocity. Complete it if the plant room imposes a hard limit.

cas_face_h.label: Maximum casing height
cas_face_h.help: Consider the clear height under pipework and the space above the unit for withdrawing components.

cas_max_l.label: Maximum length per transport section
cas_max_l.help: Determines in how many parts the unit is delivered. Every joint is a potential leak: ask how the joints are sealed and who makes them on site.

cas_door_w.label: Smallest opening on the delivery route
cas_door_w.help: Doorway, lift, stairwell or roof hatch. This item is systematically forgotten and is the most common reason for a unit having to be dismantled on site.

cas_service_side.label: Service side
cas_service_side.help: Determines on which side the inspection doors are placed. It cannot be changed after manufacture.

options.links: Left (looking in the direction of flow)

cas_service_space.label: Clear space available on the service side
cas_service_space.help: At least the casing width plus the withdrawal length of the longest component. For filters and exchangers this is often more than people expect.

cas_floor_load.label: Permissible floor loading
cas_floor_load.help: Particularly relevant for roof installations and for refurbishment. Also state whether a separate supporting structure is provided.

cas_vibration.label: Vibration isolation
cas_vibration.help: Where the unit stands above occupied spaces or on a lightweight roof structure, the vibration isolation determines whether the installation is audible. Flexible connections on all duct connections and on the pipework are part of it.

cas_roof.label: Weatherproof roof and protective hoods?
cas_roof.help: Including a rainproof outdoor air intake with droplet eliminator, a protected discharge and a frost-resistant build of all waterside components.

sec_damper_class.label: Leakage class of the dampers (EN 1751)
sec_damper_class.help: A closed class 2 damper leaks considerably when at rest. For frost protection, pressure cascades and night shutdown, class 3 is the minimum and class 4 the safe choice.

sec_damper_actuator.label: Damper actuator
sec_damper_actuator.help: Without spring return the outdoor air dampers remain open on power failure and the coil freezes and is destroyed. With a water coil and a cold climate, spring return is not an option but a requirement.

options.veerretour: With spring return (fail-safe position on power failure)

sec_mixing.label: Mixing section for recirculation?
sec_mixing.help: Recirculation saves energy but brings the contamination from the space back into the supply. For processes involving dust, vapour, odour or pathogens that is not permissible. In this tool the application profile already gives a judgement on this.

sec_mixing_pct.label: Maximum recirculation proportion
sec_mixing_pct.help: Also state the minimum fresh air proportion — that is the value the control system has to monitor and that is measured during an inspection.

sec_silencer_sup.label: Attenuator on the supply side?
sec_silencer_sup.help: Count on an attenuator costing 0.9 to 1.5 m of casing length. Anyone who forgets it only discovers this after handover — and by then there is no space left.

sec_silencer_out.label: Attenuator on the discharge to outside?
sec_silencer_out.help: Needed as soon as a noise limit towards the surroundings applies. With an outdoor installation the casing shell itself also radiates.

sec_inspection.label: Inspection windows and internal lighting?
sec_inspection.help: Mandatory for a hygienic build and in practice the only way to notice fouling before it becomes a problem.

sec_measure.label: Airflow measurement in the fan inlet?
sec_measure.help: Makes balancing, monitoring and reporting possible without separate measuring equipment. Ask about the stated measuring accuracy across the whole control range, not only at nominal airflow rate.

sec_fire_damper.label: Fire dampers in or on the unit?
sec_fire_damper.help: Set out the position, the actuation and the status feedback. Also ask who tests the fire dampers periodically and how they can be reached.

sec_empty.label: Number of empty sections
sec_empty.help: For future extension or for flow stabilisation ahead of a coil or a measuring section. Cheap now, impossible later.

sec_flex.label: Flexible duct connections to be supplied?
sec_flex.help: Prevents transmission of vibration into the ductwork.

sec_siphon.label: Traps supplied and calculated to size?
sec_siphon.help: The trap height has to match the pressure at that point in the unit. On the suction side, a trap that is too shallow is the standard cause of water in the casing and of air being drawn in through the drain. Ask for calculated traps, not for standard traps.

ctl_supplier.label: Source of the control system
ctl_supplier.help: With a mixed solution, responsibility for the performance lies nowhere clearly. If you take that route, set out for each function who supplies, who wires and who commissions.

ctl_protocol.label: Communication protocol
ctl_protocol.help: Request the points list with the quotation, not at handover. Without an agreed points list it invariably turns out afterwards that precisely the point you need is not available.

ctl_points.label: Full points list with the quotation?
ctl_points.help: Read and write points, with addresses and units.

ctl_sequences.label: Required control functions
ctl_sequences.help: The control functions determine the number of sensors, dampers and inputs and outputs. Ask the manufacturer to describe the sequence for each function, including the transitions — it is precisely there that the conflicts arise between fire mode, frost protection and normal operation.

options.vorst: Frost protection with safe shutdown sequence

ctl_integration.label: Integration with other installations
ctl_integration.help: Heat pump, chiller, boiler, fire alarm system, process control, access control of the airlocks. Describe which signal comes from whom and what has to happen if it is lost.

ctl_fire_mode.label: Is a defined fire mode required?
ctl_fire_mode.help: What does the installation do on a fire alarm: stop, keep running, switch over to smoke extraction? For a car park or an atrium this determines the temperature class of the fans.

ctl_power_fail.label: Behaviour on power failure and on restart
ctl_power_fail.help: Damper positions, pump overrun, frost protection without power, automatic or manual restart. For a process with a product being worked on, this is a product question, not an installation question.

ctl_monitoring.label: Trend logging and measurement of the energy consumption?
ctl_monitoring.help: Without measurement, every performance guarantee is unprovable. Ask as a minimum for the electrical consumption per fan, the pressure drop per filter stage and the efficiency of the heat recovery.

acu_room_limit.label: Permissible noise level in the space
acu_room_limit.help: Office 35, classroom 30–35, meeting room 30, plant room 55–65. Where the requirement is strict, the acoustics determine the size of the unit, because a lower duct velocity is the only structural solution.

acu_criterion.label: Assessment criterion
acu_criterion.help: An NR or NC curve sets a limit per octave band and is stricter on low-frequency noise — precisely where fans have their problem.

acu_outdoor_limit.label: Permissible noise level towards the surroundings
acu_outdoor_limit.help: Follows from the environmental permit or from the regional environmental conditions, and applies at the site boundary or at the nearest dwelling. Night-time values are governing.

acu_outdoor_dist.label: Distance to the nearest assessment point
acu_outdoor_dist.help: Needed in order to determine whether the discharge and the casing shell have to be attenuated.

acu_breakout.label: Is casing breakout noise relevant?
