acu_breakout.help: Relevant if the unit stands in or next to an occupied space, or outdoors near dwellings. Ask for the radiated sound power of the casing, not only for the values at the connections.

acu_octave.label: Request sound power levels per octave band?
acu_octave.help: Supply, extract, outdoor air intake, discharge and casing separately, from 63 to 8000 Hz. Without this data no acoustic calculation whatsoever can be made.

nrm_erp.label: Demonstrate Ecodesign conformity (EU 1253/2014)?
nrm_erp.help: Mandatory for ventilation units on the European market. Request the product information sheet with the measured values, not only the declaration of conformity.

nrm_eurovent.label: Is Eurovent certification of the performance required?
nrm_eurovent.help: Certification means that the stated performance has been verified by a third party. Without certification you are comparing figures from manufacturers who each use their own measuring method.

nrm_en1886.label: Set the EN 1886 classes out contractually?

nrm_atex.label: Does ATEX zoning apply?
nrm_atex.help: Where there is dust or vapour with an explosion risk. It determines the build of the fan, motor, sensors and wiring, and sometimes the location of the unit itself. Request the zoning document for the project.

nrm_hygiene_audit.label: Hygiene inspection at handover?
nrm_hygiene_audit.help: Visual and microbiological inspection in accordance with VDI 6022 or the healthcare standard, with a report. This is the baseline against which later maintenance is measured.

nrm_extra.label: Other standards and project requirements
nrm_extra.help: For example a client's specification, a certification scheme, fire regulations or requirements from the insurer.

com_commissioning.label: Commissioning by the manufacturer?
com_commissioning.help: Including running through all operating states, the abnormal ones as well: frost, fire, failure, cleaning.

com_balancing.label: Balancing and measurement report?
com_balancing.help: Airflow rates, pressures, temperatures, noise level and power input, measured and reported. Without a baseline measurement it cannot later be established whether anything has changed.

com_documentation.label: Documentation required
com_documentation.help: Ask for this with the quotation, not on delivery. A selection report with the quotation lets you genuinely compare the figures from different manufacturers.

options.selectie: Selection report with all performance points
options.reserve: Spare parts list with part numbers

com_warranty.label: Warranty period required
com_warranty.help: Also ask what exactly the warranty covers and what maintenance obligation is attached to it.

com_spares.label: Supply a set of spare filters?
com_spares.help: The first set of filters fills up with construction dust during the building phase. Count on replacement at handover.

options.volledig: Full — including controls and performance checks

com_leadtime.label: Required lead time or delivery date
com_leadtime.help: Also ask about the lead time for the control system separately: it is often longer than that of the unit.

com_hours.label: Operating hours per year (for the energy estimate)

com_degree_days.label: Degree days
com_degree_days.help: For Belgium generally around 2000 K·d (base 15/15). Used only for the indicative annual estimate on this sheet.

com_budget.label: Budget indication
com_budget.help: An order of magnitude helps the manufacturer to choose the right level of build instead of guessing.

lev_route.label: Delivery route to the final position
lev_route.help: Describe the whole route: street, gateway, courtyard, doorways, corridors, stairwell, lift, roof hatch. Measure the narrowest opening; do not assume it. Watch the corners as well: a 2.4 m section will not turn a 1.5 m corner, even though both dimensions fit on their own.

lev_method.label: Method of placement
lev_method.help: Determines who organises what and what it costs. With a tower crane still standing on site, placement is almost free; three months later the same placement is a separate crane day with a road closure. The sequencing of the site matters more here than the technology.

options.rollen: Rolling and jacking across the floor

lev_crane_space.label: Is there a set-up area for the crane?
lev_crane_space.help: A mobile crane needs a level, load-bearing surface for its outriggers, plus clear space around it. Look at basements and parking decks beneath the set-up area, at manholes, at trees and at overhead lines. This is a question for the contractor, not for the manufacturer — but you have to ask it.

lev_crane_radius.label: Radius required (horizontal distance crane → final position)
lev_crane_radius.help: Together with the mass, the radius determines the crane class, and that determines the price. Lifting capacity falls sharply with distance: the same crane that lifts 8 tonnes at 10 m manages only a fraction of that at 30 m.

lev_crane_height.label: Lift height to roof level
lev_crane_height.help: Plus the height of the package itself and of the lifting gear. Do not forget that the load has to be lifted over the roof edge, not just up to it.

lev_obstacles.label: Obstructions in the lifting path
lev_obstacles.help: Overhead power lines, tram wires, trees, adjoining buildings, crane oversailing above public land or above the neighbouring plot. Oversailing beyond your own site boundary requires permission and sometimes insurance.

lev_permit.label: Permit or road closure needed for the placement day?
lev_permit.help: Street occupation, parking suspension, police authorisation. In many municipalities the lead time for the application runs to several weeks and therefore governs the programme — not the delivery time of the unit.

options.ja_nog: Yes — still to be applied for

lev_lifting_points.label: Lifting eyes or spreader beam supplied, with a lifting instruction?
lev_lifting_points.help: Obtain the manufacturer's lifting instruction: attachment points, permissible sling angle, centre of gravity per section and whether a spreader beam is required. A unit slung from the wrong points distorts and loses its leakage class — invisibly, until handover.

lev_section_weight_max.label: Maximum permissible package mass
lev_section_weight_max.help: Follows from the crane, the builder's hoist or the floor it is rolled over. State the limit, so that the manufacturer can match the split into transport sections to it rather than the other way round.

lev_roof_structure.label: Type of roof structure
lev_roof_structure.help: Determines how the load has to be spread. On a steel roof deck the unit must always land on the purlins beneath it, never on the deck itself; that means the position of the unit is set by the structure, not by the duct connections.

lev_roof_confirmed.label: Has the load-bearing capacity been confirmed by the structural engineer?
lev_roof_confirmed.help: The only question in this list with a genuine safety risk. A structural engineer has to confirm it on the basis of the actual mass including water, snow and maintenance loading — not on the basis of a catalogue weight. In a refurbishment the original design is rarely calculated for this load. Do not order before this is settled.

lev_roof_area.label: Clear roof area at the intended position
lev_roof_area.help: The unit plus the clear service space around it plus the room to withdraw components. Allow for the unit dimensions plus roughly one unit width on the service side.

lev_roof_occupied.label: What is already on the roof?
lev_roof_occupied.help: Other units, chillers, rooflights, roof lanterns, solar panels, fall protection, smoke vents, aerials. Solar panels are the new classic here: the roof is full, and relocating them costs more than the air handling unit. Look as well at shading and at the distance to the discharge of existing installations.

lev_base.label: Support structure
lev_base.help: Also: who supplies it and who installs it? The support structure often falls between the contractor, the roofing contractor and the installer, and then turns out to have been priced by nobody. Allow sufficient height above roof level for drainage, snow and maintenance beneath the unit.

options.dakstoel: Steel roof cradle bearing onto the purlins

lev_roof_seal.label: Who forms and seals the roof penetrations?
lev_roof_seal.help: Duct, pipe and cable penetrations break through the roof waterproofing and the vapour control layer. Fix who forms them, who makes them watertight and how that affects the roof warranty — it often lapses once a third party works on it.

lev_wind.label: Wind anchorage calculated and provided?
lev_wind.help: An outdoor unit is a large surface at a high point. The anchorage should be calculated for the local wind loading, and the forces must be taken into the structure — not into the roof covering.

lev_roof_access.label: Permanent roof access and fall protection
lev_roof_access.help: Without safe and easy access, filters do not get changed and maintenance is put off. This is not a formality: it determines whether the installation still delivers what it promises after three years. Ask as well how heavy material is to be got up there.

options.ja: Fixed stair or ladder and collective edge protection in place
options.deels: Partly — anchor points, personal fall protection

lev_replacement.label: Will replacement of the largest component still be possible later?
lev_replacement.help: Think of the exchanger, a coil or a fan module, in ten or fifteen years' time — when the plant room has been built up around it or the roof is full. Ask the manufacturer which components are withdrawable and from which side, and keep that route clear.

lev_storage.label: Temporary storage on site possible?
lev_storage.help: If the unit cannot be placed straight away, it has to stand dry and secure. A unit that stands in the rain for weeks begins its life with moisture in the insulation and corrosion in the coils. With "no", delivery has to fall exactly on the placement day, and that makes the programme tight.

lev_responsible.label: Who coordinates unloading, craning and placement?
lev_responsible.help: One name. If it is missing, everyone assumes somebody else is arranging it — and you find that out on the day itself.

omg_intake_pos.label: Position and orientation of the outdoor air intake
omg_intake_pos.help: Façade or roof, height above ground level or above roof level, the wind direction the intake faces. An intake 1 m above a car park draws in exhaust fumes; the same intake 3 m higher on the other façade does not. This is the cheapest intervention in the whole design.

omg_exhaust_dist.label: Distance between the outdoor air intake and the unit's own discharge
omg_exhaust_dist.help: Too close together and the installation draws its own exhaust air back in — short-circuiting. The efficiency of the heat recovery then looks excellent while in reality hardly any fresh air is coming in. Keep a generous distance, or discharge vertically and unobstructed upwards.

omg_wind.label: Position relative to the prevailing wind direction
omg_wind.help: In our region the wind is predominantly from the south-west. If the intake lies downwind of an emission source, the wind carries that source indoors all year round.

options.gunstig: Favourable — intake upwind of the sources

omg_sources.label: Emission sources in the vicinity of the intake
omg_sources.help: Every source ticked changes something: the filter class, the position of the intake, or the need for gas-phase filtration. A cooling tower within a few tens of metres is moreover a legionella risk and not a filter matter — that intake simply has to go somewhere else.

options.parkeren: Car park exit or loading bay
options.zuivering: Water treatment plant or sewer outfall
options.landbouw: Agriculture — manure spreading, crop protection, livestock housing
options.bouwwerf: Construction site during the building phase
options.begroeiing: Trees — pollen, leaf fall, seed fluff

omg_rail_dist.label: Distance to a railway or tramway
omg_rail_dist.help: Two effects at once: vibration through the structure, and brake dust — fine iron particles that considerably increase the particulate loading on the intake. Each calls for its own measure; a heavier filter does not solve the vibration problem.

omg_hv.label: High-voltage line, substation or traction supply nearby?
omg_hv.help: Two consequences. For the placement: a crane must not come within the safety distance of a live line, and that distance is greater than people think. For operation: induced interference on sensor and bus cables. Ask for screened cabling and separate cable routes.

omg_airport.label: Airport or approach path in the vicinity?
omg_airport.help: Relevant to the height of a crane: within the obstacle limitation surfaces a height restriction applies and sometimes a separate authorisation. The background noise may also mean that the noise requirement is judged differently — but do not count on it.

omg_flood.label: Susceptible to flooding or standing water?
omg_flood.help: For installation at ground level or in a basement this determines the plinth height, the position of the electrical connections and whether the unit belongs there at all.

omg_snow.label: Snow accumulation, falling ice or water blowing off a higher roof?
omg_snow.help: External louvres blocked with snow bring the installation to a standstill at exactly the coldest moment. Set the louvres high enough above roof level and allow for drifting snow, not only for the depth of the snow layer.

omg_security.label: Accessibility of the installation position
omg_security.help: Where there is public access: lockable doors, protected cabling, and attention to the security of the outdoor air intake itself. An intake within reach is a vulnerable point of the building.

omg_lightning.label: Lightning protection and earthing of the installed unit provided?
omg_lightning.help: A metal casing at the highest point of the building belongs in the lightning protection concept and on the equipotential bonding. Fix who carries that out — it often falls between the electrician and the installer.

omg_phasing.label: Construction phasing and use during the works
omg_phasing.help: Will the installation already be running during the finishing works? Then the first set of filters loads up with construction dust and moisture gets into the ductwork. Agree whether it will run on construction-phase filters and who replaces them at handover.

cor_atmosphere.label: Corrosivity of the outdoor air (ISO 9223)
cor_atmosphere.help: The standard measure of atmospheric corrosivity; ISO 12944 links paint systems and expected service life to it. Ask the manufacturer to confirm his construction against this category instead of against the words "coastal build", which fix nothing.

cor_deicing.label: Road de-icing salt nearby — motorway, bridge or salted car park?
cor_deicing.help: De-icing salt spray is chemically the same problem as sea salt and is structurally overlooked, even hundreds of kilometres from the coast. Relevant for an intake at ground level alongside a salted road.

cor_airstream.label: Aggressive constituents in the air stream
cor_airstream.help: This is the question that determines the service life of the coils. Aluminium fins do not withstand chlorine, ammonia, strong acids or alkalis; copper does not withstand ammonia and sulphur compounds. Tick what the extract air contains, not only what the supply air contains — the extract side of the heat recovery stands in it permanently.

options.chloriden: Salts or chlorides (sea salt, brine, food)
options.geen: None — normal indoor and outdoor air

cor_cleaning.label: Cleaning regime of the casing
cor_cleaning.help: Chlorine-based cleaning and disinfection agents cause stress corrosion cracking in ordinary stainless steel. With that regime 316L is needed, not 304 — a difference that looks small on the quotation and is decisive in practice.

options.nat: Wet — water and a neutral cleaning agent

cor_casing_material.label: Construction of the casing and the frame
cor_casing_material.help: Ask for the build-up of both sheet skins separately: the inner skin stands in the air stream, the outer skin in the atmosphere. With a hygienic construction the cleanability of the inner skin moreover counts for more than the thickness of the coating.

cor_coil_material.label: Construction of the coils
cor_coil_material.help: The fins are thin and have the largest surface area: that is where every corrosion failure begins, long before anything can be seen on the casing. An e-coat also covers the edges and the contact zone between fin and tube; a dip coating often does not do so completely. Ask for the coating thickness and for the behaviour at the tube penetrations.

options.dipcoat: Dip coating on the assembled block

cor_tray.label: Construction of the condensate trays
cor_tray.help: The condensate tray stands permanently in water in which everything the air brings with it dissolves. Galvanised trays are the most common early failure in a unit. Ask as well for full fall to the drain point: a tray without fall is a breeding ground, whatever the material.

cor_fasteners.label: Fasteners
cor_fasteners.help: Stainless panels on galvanised bolts give galvanic corrosion and loose connections. At C4 and above, and in any chlorine-bearing environment, A4 is the lower limit.

cor_lifetime.label: Expected technical service life
cor_lifetime.help: Ask the manufacturer to substantiate his choice of materials against this period and against the stated corrosivity category. Without a period, every construction is "adequate".

atx_relevant.label: Is there an explosion risk in the air stream or at the installation position?
atx_relevant.help: Explosion protection involves two independent questions: what passes through the unit, and where the unit stands. A wood dust extraction system can have a zone in the air stream while the plant room is unzoned — and the other way round.

atx_document.label: Is there a zoning plan or explosion protection document?
atx_document.help: Without a zoning document no manufacturer can offer a compliant construction and nobody can demonstrate compliance afterwards. This document is the responsibility of the employer or operator and should exist before the enquiry goes out.

atx_zone_inside.label: Zone in the air stream
atx_zone_inside.help: Determines the equipment category of everything standing in the air stream: impeller, motor, sensors, heating element and lighting. A zone inside rules out an electric heating element and usually also heat recovery with carry-over.

atx_zone_outside.label: Zone at the installation position
atx_zone_outside.help: Determines the construction of the outside: motor terminal box, isolator switch, cabling, control panel. Often the solution is to place the control panel outside the zone rather than to order it in an explosion-protected construction — that is usually cheaper and always easier to maintain.

atx_substance.label: Dust or gas and the governing properties
atx_substance.help: Name, lower explosive limit, and for dust the minimum ignition temperature of cloud and layer plus the Kst value. These figures determine the temperature class and the venting calculation; without them it is guesswork.

atx_temp_class.label: Temperature class
atx_temp_class.help: The maximum surface temperature the equipment may reach, including under fault conditions — think of a blocked impeller or a bearing that has run dry. With dust the layer ignition temperature applies as well, and that can lie lower than the class suggests.

atx_fan.label: Construction of the fan
atx_fan.help: Spark-reduced means a controlled combination of materials between impeller, housing and inlet cone, plus sufficient clearance and an earthed shaft. Note: a spark-reduced impeller in a plastic housing is not spark-reduced. The most elegant solution is often to bring the fan outside the zone — discuss that before the selection.

atx_antistatic.label: Antistatic construction of filters, seals and flexible connections?
atx_antistatic.help: Filter media and plastic components build up a static charge and are then an ignition source in their own right. Within a zone they should be conductive and bonded through to the earthing. This is almost always forgotten because the filter is seen as "passive".

atx_earthing.label: Equipotential bonding of all conductive parts?
atx_earthing.help: Casing, ductwork, flexible connections, filter frames and the dust extraction ducting must be bonded through and earthed, with a measurable contact resistance. Ask for that as a handover point, not as a construction detail.

atx_decoupling.label: Explosion isolation and venting in the dust extraction system
atx_decoupling.help: A dust extraction system with a filter or a cyclone requires venting to a safe place and isolation, so that an explosion does not propagate along the ducting into the workspace. This stands apart from the air handling unit, but the air balance and the make-up air do not — state both together.
